package private

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/usecase"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
)

type sessionSummaryRepositoryStub struct{}

func (sessionSummaryRepositoryStub) GetLearningSessionSummary(_ context.Context, studentID, sessionID uuid.UUID) (*domain.LearningSessionSummary, error) {
	return &domain.LearningSessionSummary{StudentID: studentID, AnalyticsSessionID: sessionID}, nil
}

func TestRegisterProtectsLearningSessionSummaryWithExactToken(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	service := usecase.NewLearningSessionSummaryService(sessionSummaryRepositoryStub{})
	NewRouter("secret", service).Register(e.Group("/internal"))
	studentID, sessionID := uuid.New(), uuid.New()
	path := "/internal/v1/students/" + studentID.String() + "/learning-sessions/" + sessionID.String() + "/summary"

	unauthorized := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	unauthorized.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "wrong")
	unauthorizedResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(unauthorizedResponse, unauthorized)
	if unauthorizedResponse.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Fatalf("expected unauthorized, got %d", unauthorizedResponse.Code)
	}

	authorized := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	authorized.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "secret")
	authorizedResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(authorizedResponse, authorized)
	if authorizedResponse.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected ok, got %d: %s", authorizedResponse.Code, authorizedResponse.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestRegisterOmitsPrivateSummaryWithoutToken(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	NewRouter("", usecase.NewLearningSessionSummaryService(sessionSummaryRepositoryStub{})).Register(e.Group("/internal"))
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/v1/students/"+uuid.NewString()+"/learning-sessions/"+uuid.NewString()+"/summary", nil)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("expected route to be absent, got %d", response.Code)
	}
}
